scope: Four preselected input cases; frozen R10A400 enhancement and physical values; official frozen Wan text embedding/K/norm. One same-weight request-refinement intervention. No R15E training or video generation.
finding: Real native text keys produce strongly token-dependent, partly interpretable C affinities; the prior is not constant. This validates availability of a signal, not correctness of every physical relation or generation gains.

examples.interpretation: Affinities favor the actual fracture description
Lexical matching still selects outward water flow, while the request requires removing water; physical process mismatch cannot be solved by lexical routing alone

cautions: Same frozen R10A weights, not trained R15E; no benchmark or video quality gain measured.
The value-selection metric omits video-dependent physical query logits and state interaction; it is not the final write.
Changing to request-only contextual refinement decreases this proxy value variation in all4 cases. More diversity is not a success criterion; evaluate physical/semantic processes and scores.
Semantic affinity may retrieve a relevant entity with an incorrect process. Request refinement and direct generation training remain necessary parts of the proposed approach.
decision: Retain the combined candidate for full training evaluation; no new loss, gate or extra branch added in response to this feasibility audit.
